hook.name: StableSwap
hook.description: A custom stable swap hook implementing a 1:1 AMM with a 0.05% fee, depositing pool liquidity into Aave V3 and distributing accrued interest to swappers as a bonus. Standard liquidity addition is blocked; LPs must use the hook's custom deposit/withdraw functions. Contains privileged emergencyWithdraw and unconstrained multicall backdoors controlled by a hardcoded admin address.
